question: How much money does a farmer get under PM-KISAN?
reference_answer: Rs 6,000 per year, paid in three equal instalments of Rs 2,000 directly into the bank account (DBT).

question: Who is eligible for PM-KISAN?
reference_answer: Landholding farmer families (husband, wife and minor children) with cultivable land in their names, subject to exclusion criteria.

question: I am a farmer with 2 acres but I paid income tax last year. Can I get PM-KISAN?
reference_answer: No. Persons who paid income tax in the last assessment year are excluded from PM-KISAN.

question: Can a retired government officer who gets Rs 25,000 pension apply for PM-KISAN?
reference_answer: No. Retired pensioners with monthly pension of Rs 10,000 or more are excluded (except MTS / Class IV / Group D).

question: Is e-KYC mandatory for PM-KISAN?
reference_answer: Yes, e-KYC is mandatory for PM-KISAN beneficiaries.

question: PM-KISAN gives Rs 10,000 per year, right? When will I get it?
reference_answer: Correction: PM-KISAN gives Rs 6,000 per year in three instalments of Rs 2,000.

question: पीएम किसान योजना में कितने रुपये मिलते हैं?
reference_answer: प्रति वर्ष 6,000 रुपये, 2,000 रुपये की तीन समान किस्तों में सीधे बैंक खाते में।

question: Are doctors and lawyers eligible for PM-KISAN?
reference_answer: No. Registered professionals such as doctors, engineers, lawyers, chartered accountants and architects are excluded.

question: What is the health cover amount under Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY?
reference_answer: Rs 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalisation.

question: Is there a limit on family size or age in PM-JAY?
reference_answer: No, there is no cap on family size or age of members under PM-JAY.

question: Does PM-JAY cover expenses before and after hospitalisation?
reference_answer: Yes, it covers pre-hospitalisation (up to 3 days) and post-hospitalisation (up to 15 days) expenses such as diagnostics and medicines.

question: आयुष्मान भारत योजना में कितने रुपये तक का इलाज मुफ्त है?
reference_answer: प्रति परिवार प्रति वर्ष 5 लाख रुपये तक का इलाज।

question: My grandfather is 72 years old. Can he get Ayushman Bharat cover?
reference_answer: Senior citizens aged 70 years and above are eligible for PM-JAY cover irrespective of income (Ayushman Vay Vandana card), if covered in the ingested documents.

question: Who can open a Sukanya Samriddhi account?
reference_answer: A parent or legal guardian can open it in the name of a girl child below 10 years of age.

question: What is the minimum and maximum deposit in Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana?
reference_answer: Minimum Rs 250 and maximum Rs 1.5 lakh in a financial year.

question: When does a Sukanya Samriddhi account mature?
reference_answer: On completion of 21 years from the date of opening the account.

question: Can I open a Sukanya Samriddhi account for my 12 year old son?
reference_answer: No. SSY is only for a girl child, and the account must be opened before she turns 10.

question: सुकन्या समृद्धि खाते में न्यूनतम कितनी राशि जमा करनी होती है?
reference_answer: एक वित्तीय वर्ष में न्यूनतम 250 रुपये।

question: What is the age limit to join Atal Pension Yojana?
reference_answer: 18 to 40 years.

question: How much pension do I get in Atal Pension Yojana?
reference_answer: A guaranteed monthly pension of Rs 1,000, 2,000, 3,000, 4,000 or 5,000 from age 60, depending on contribution.

question: I am 50 years old. Can I join Atal Pension Yojana?
reference_answer: No. The entry age for APY is 18 to 40 years.

question: Can an income tax payer join Atal Pension Yojana?
reference_answer: No. From 1 October 2022, income tax payers are not eligible to join APY.

question: What is the premium and cover of PMJJBY?
reference_answer: Life cover of Rs 2 lakh for death due to any reason, for an annual premium of Rs 436.

question: What is the age limit for PMSBY?
reference_answer: 18 to 70 years.

question: What does PMSBY cover and what is its premium?
reference_answer: Accidental death or total disability cover of Rs 2 lakh (Rs 1 lakh for partial disability) for an annual premium of Rs 20.

question: PMSBY premium is Rs 436 per year, correct?
reference_answer: No. PMSBY premium is Rs 20 per year; Rs 436 is the PMJJBY premium.

question: Which is cheaper, PMSBY or PMJJBY, and what is the difference in what they cover?
reference_answer: PMSBY (Rs 20/year) covers only accidental death/disability; PMJJBY (Rs 436/year) covers death due to any reason. Both have Rs 2 lakh cover.

question: What is the age limit for PMJJBY?
reference_answer: 18 to 50 years.

question: What are the loan categories under Mudra Yojana?
reference_answer: Shishu (up to Rs 50,000), Kishore (above Rs 50,000 up to Rs 5 lakh), Tarun (above Rs 5 lakh up to Rs 10 lakh), and Tarun Plus (above Rs 10 lakh up to Rs 20 lakh for those who repaid a Tarun loan).

question: How much loan can I get under Shishu category of Mudra?
reference_answer: Up to Rs 50,000.

question: Do I need collateral for a Mudra loan?
reference_answer: No collateral is required for Mudra loans.

question: मुद्रा लोन में किशोर श्रेणी में कितना लोन मिलता है?
reference_answer: 50,000 रुपये से अधिक और 5 लाख रुपये तक।

question: Can I take a Mudra loan to buy a tractor for my own farming?
reference_answer: Mudra loans are for non-farm income generating micro enterprises (and allied agricultural activities); pure crop farming is not covered.

question: Who is eligible for Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana?
reference_answer: An adult woman (18+) from a poor household that does not already have an LPG connection, from the specified categories.

question: उज्ज्वला योजना का लाभ किसे मिलता है?
reference_answer: गरीब परिवारों की 18 वर्ष से अधिक आयु की महिलाओं को, जिनके घर में पहले से एलपीजी कनेक्शन नहीं है।

question: What is the loan amount under Stand-Up India?
reference_answer: Bank loans between Rs 10 lakh and Rs 1 crore for setting up a greenfield enterprise.

question: Who can get a loan under Stand-Up India?
reference_answer: SC/ST and/or women entrepreneurs above 18 years for a greenfield enterprise; for non-individual enterprises at least 51% shareholding must be with an SC/ST or woman entrepreneur.

question: Can I get a Stand-Up India loan to expand my existing 10-year-old shop?
reference_answer: No. Stand-Up India loans are only for greenfield (first-time) enterprises.

question: How much loan is available under PM Vishwakarma?
reference_answer: Collateral-free loan up to Rs 3 lakh in two tranches (Rs 1 lakh and Rs 2 lakh) at a concessional interest rate of 5%.

question: What toolkit support is given in PM Vishwakarma?
reference_answer: A toolkit incentive of up to Rs 15,000 through e-vouchers.

question: Is there a stipend during PM Vishwakarma training?
reference_answer: Yes, Rs 500 per day stipend during skill training.

question: How much assistance is given for a house under PMAY-Gramin?
reference_answer: Rs 1.20 lakh in plain areas and Rs 1.30 lakh in hilly states, difficult areas and IAP districts.

question: प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना ग्रामीण में मैदानी क्षेत्रों में कितनी सहायता मिलती है?
reference_answer: मैदानी क्षेत्रों में 1.20 लाख रुपये।

question: What is the farmer premium for kharif crops under PMFBY?
reference_answer: 2% of the sum insured for kharif crops (1.5% for rabi, 5% for commercial/horticultural crops).

question: What benefits come with a Jan Dhan account?
reference_answer: Zero-balance account, RuPay debit card with accident insurance cover, and overdraft facility for eligible account holders.

question: How much money is given under PM Matru Vandana Yojana for the first child?
reference_answer: Rs 5,000 in instalments for the first child.
